summary: Fixes a weakness in TLS where the master secret was not tied to the session details such as the server certificate. An active attacker could set up two sessions that share the same secret and then exploit session resumption or other authentication. This extension binds the secret to the handshake. It was replaced by RFC 9846.

eli5.summary: Two locks accidentally used the same key, so a trickster could swap between them. This makes each key unique to its own conversation. It was replaced by RFC 9846.
